column1: # RNW regionIdent table — region code -> regionIdent (profile 1 / CCP)
# regionIdent = (profile<<10)|codeId ; all shipped RNW regions use profile 1 (folder CCP).
# FINALIZED 2026-09 via two independent, mutually-confirming empirical methods over the
#       {u32 fileOffset = (cluster offset & ~0x3FFF) | regionIdent, u16 length, u16 fileId}
#    older docs had len/fid swapped). fileId -> per-region NAV%05u.DAT inventory; require
#    in-bounds; count single-owner refs. The .tci master on this card only references six
#   records, bRead @0x008910cc) packs the SAME ident-bearing fileOffset word. Parse every
#   region folder's NAV clusters, take the dominant low-14-bit value of the ci records:
#   reproduces ALL SIX values of (1) exactly and yields the remaining 11 regions.
#   Secondary (minority) idents inside a folder are genuine border-neighbour refs
#   (e.g. EEU clusters reference a few DEU clusters).
# This CORRECTS the retired NAV_ROOT-histogram table: it had FRM 0x403 (really GRC),
# GRC 0x406 (used nowhere), TUR 0x407 (really BNL), BNL 0x404 (really TUR), MLC 0x40a
# (really FRM). POL 0x402 is now CONFIRMED (ci-scan 12975 refs) - the legacy value was right.
# Semantics: the packed codeId matters for cross-region lookups (.tci pools, ci adjacency);
# per-region NAV_ROOT.DAT refs usually leave codeId zero (region implicit). POL caveat
# stands: no .tci shard references POL (N6E2102.TCI is an empty stub) - on-device capture
# (diag/routeprobe_logger.sh) decides whether a .tci swap can ever drive Polish routing.
